data.text:
**Visual Quality Review — Result: No critical defects found**

Concrete issues detected:

- **Minor: Icon/greeting mismatch** — The header shows a sun icon paired with "İyi Geceler, Rojda!" (Good evening). A moon icon would be semantically consistent; this is a visible inconsistency, though not overflow/clipping/contrast.

Checked and found **no issues**:
- No text overflow or clipping anywhere (labels, buttons, chips all fit their containers).
- No overlapping elements (sidebar icons, top bar chips, path nodes 1–5, and the "Tüm konular" link are all cleanly separated).
- Contrast is readable throughout: white text on dark green and orange cards is sufficient; inactive sidebar labels (Yarış, Liderlik, Profil) use standard muted styling but remain legible.

Overall: the screen renders cleanly with only the sun icon vs. evening greeting as a minor visual-content inconsistency.
